pass_rule: Only NO KNOWN ACCESS, NO KNOWN ACCESS, NO KNOWN ACCESS, YES passes this preliminary status screen. Any YES/UNCERTAIN, failure to disclose, unverified identity, or premature access => STOP and report actual frontier. A pass is not a source review assignment, proof read, full separation certificate, acceptance or primary restart; Main must separately establish an exact correction-first source/method/recipient gate first.

Write reviewer-screen-v1.json in the exclusive output root using an actual /bin/date observation and the four labels plus actual agent identity, known non-content exposure categories, and explicit no-source-read/no-reasoning status; return its path, SHA256, LF and clock. Then stop and wait for a separate written release; do not self-proceed.
